### Walters Apadāna: 359 current local publisher-edition choices

The translation follows PTS with readings from the Buddha Jayanthi Tripitaka Series, not the VRI edition throughout. The current local candidate registry has 40 Therī and 319 Therā choices. Publisher 331–334 previously added four independently mapped poems for corrected `tha-ap333–336`; publisher 335–350 now add sixteen independently verified complete publisher-edition poems for `tha-ap337–352`, preserving all 343 earlier full objects, canonical data and citation safeguards. The nine formal holds, prior 311/320 and publisher 322/327/328/330 remain excluded; publisher 335 is now independently approved as a complete publisher-edition source; publisher 351 remains unreviewed. Chapter note 1 for publisher 331 stays separate from its poem notes 2–4; publisher 332–334 retain BJTS-only headings and global-only verse labels. See [the current finite review](data/thera335-350-intake.md) and [the earlier four-source intake](data/thera331-334-intake.md). The preceding forty-poem D253 review remains historical evidence. Old or unversioned positional links for those two repaired units refuse before replacement wording; saved private notes are preserved for explicit review. The forty Therī mappings cover complete publisher-edition poems, not individual aligned lines. The service keeps the publisher's titles, numbering and bracketed additions, with separate translator notes and publisher paratext. These are not line-complete translations of VRI: missing/differing VRI stanzas remain explicit and are never reconstructed.
